item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.100
item.description:
Release v1.0.100 adds new CLI flags and session/share commands, expands plugin and sandbox handling, and improves account, permission, and model management flows. It also fixes a wide range of reliability issues across MCP, Gemini, Windows, proxy, telemetry, and session browsing.
